description:
You: update the demo host to the merged commit, so the demo runs the new release.

## What it changes

- **Downtime:** visitors can't reach demo.example.com for about 2 minutes.
- **Your time:** about 5 minutes.
- **Undo:** start the previous release again.

## How we'll confirm

- The health check at demo.example.com answers `200`.
title: Update the demo host to the new release
